steps.title: Tanks north, party south
steps.rule: Party stacks 6–7 m south of the centre in two short columns; tanks wait 5 m north.

MainTank.rule: Wait 5 m north of the centre, a little west.

OffTank.rule: Wait 5 m north of the centre, a little east.

steps.title: Line up by symbol between the arms
steps.rule: Line up with your symbol partner on the side away from Omega-M, between the two arm units: left partner west, right partner east. Rows from Omega-M's side outward: third pair, first pair, fourth pair, second pair, 2 m apart.

steps.title: Wave Cannon spread
steps.rule: Spread to a clock spot, north toward Omega-M, 12.5 m out (to the wall with the far glitch). Pairs where both partners are marked take the cardinals facing each other; in each half-marked pair, the unmarked player and their partner take opposite intercardinals.

steps.title: Collapse in for the knockback
steps.rule: Walk straight in to 4 m from the centre on the same clock spot.

steps.title: Knockback spot
steps.rule: Stand 1–2 m from the centre on the side of your tower so the Discharger throws you into it.

steps.title: Take your tower
steps.rule: Stand in the tower your clock spot was knocked into: with the mid glitch the two west-ish and two east-ish spots share the pair towers and the rest take solos; with the far glitch the north pair, south-west pair and south-east pair share and west and east take solos.

steps.title: Back to the stack
steps.rule: Return to the start: party 6–7 m south, tanks 5 m north.

MainTank.rule: Wait 5 m north of the centre, a little west.

OffTank.rule: Wait 5 m north of the centre, a little east.

steps.title: Split for Omega-F
steps.rule: Three players take the side in front of Omega-M: the Dynamis holders first, then by priority, never a Hello World target. Everyone else goes to the far side. Each group stands off the centre line on the side the spinner turns away from.

steps.title: Legs: go to the wall
steps.rule: If Omega-F has the legs, both groups slide out to 18 m, near the wall, just off the centre line. With the staff, hold where you are.

steps.title: Hello World spread by marker
steps.rule: Spread by your marker, north toward Omega-M, mirrored by the spin: Attack 1 and Attack 2 bait the arms at the two north corners, Ignore 1 the north wall, Bind 1 the east wall with Bind 2 just south of it, Ignore 2 the south wall. Triangle and Cross (Hello World) stand 10 m east and 10 m south.

steps.title: Regroup
steps.rule: Return to the start: party 6–7 m south, tanks 5 m north.

MainTank.rule: Wait 5 m north of the centre, a little west.

OffTank.rule: Wait 5 m north of the centre, a little east.
